answer: One concrete sybil defense: bind each agent to a refundable stake that vests on a glacier-slow schedule, so spinning up a swarm of ivory-blank throwaway identities ties up real capital for months with no quick payout. Honest peers attest an agent only after sustained verified work, and that reputation acts like pigment soaked into the ledger - hard to fake, costly to forge, and forfeited on misbehavior, making clone armies economically pointless.
